findings.title: Engine and readable recovery
findings.claim: Electron wrapper loads HTML and JavaScript; no Unity managed/IL2CPP recovery was needed. Static table substitution leaves zero literal decoder calls.
findings.limits_or_contradiction: Expected Unity was wrong.

findings.label: seen in data or code
findings.title: Ordinary rebirth replays the opening
findings.claim: a0_0x1b99d1 clears exploration/construction completion flags, resources, action queue and life clock; increments generation. It keeps instinct state and cumulative completions. Opening exploration 0 is always visible. No body/location/era/family roll appears in this transition or initial schema.
findings.limits_or_contradiction: This is not source evidence for random rebirth. Absence statement is bounded to inspected reset/schema, not every possible hidden branch.

findings.label: seen in text
findings.title: Loop fiction explicitly returns to the same time
findings.claim: Amy describes returning to the exact same point in time, while ordinary friends forget. Other cyclic beings can recognize the protagonist. The earlier resurrection legend is presented as unverified mythology within the story.
findings.limits_or_contradiction: Same-origin replay and exceptional recognition contradict a uniformly persistent social world.

findings.label: seen in data or code
findings.title: A life is timed survival, not a year-by-year biography
findings.claim: Fresh state starts at 100 health/maxHealth and generation 1. lifeTickClock advances when active actions consume milliseconds. Reviewed state has no birth age, youth/adult/elder or fertility fields. Health reaching zero resolves death after food handling.
findings.locators: decoded.js:17243-17356; 15930-15954 a0_0x409802; 15259-15275 death branch; 15790-15827 food/damage handling
findings.limits_or_contradiction: Do not relabel elapsed minutes as chronological aging or family simulation.

findings.label: seen in data or code
findings.title: Compounding survival pressure
findings.claim: Base per-ms geometric factor is 1.0000037191, approximately 1.25 per active minute. Damage integrates the geometric curve and adds action-specific damage. Hut has decayMultiplier 0.5; fights add per-ms damage.
findings.limits_or_contradiction: Exponential pressure forces recurring death; no endless safe adulthood is shown by this loop.

findings.label: seen in data or code
findings.title: Permanent max-health reward
findings.claim: On death maxHealth adds floor((1.1^(life milliseconds/60000)-1)*rewardMultiplier), guarded by dnaThisLife being null. Multiplier includes completed reward structures/explorations and NG+ perk 7. Reincarnation preserves base maxHealth; temporary construction multipliers still reset.
findings.limits_or_contradiction: More survival yields more numeric power, not just more options.

findings.label: seen in data or code
findings.title: Two skill ledgers
findings.claim: Same awarded XP goes into generationExperience and instinctExperience. Generation XP scale starts at 90 and grows 1.11; instinct starts at 1250 and grows 1.02. Speed multiplier combines 1.05^generationLevel and 1.01^instinctLevel with tools/discovery. Generation fields reset; instinct fields remain.
findings.limits_or_contradiction: Cross-life speed is implemented directly; it is not inherited property or a learned manual.

findings.label: seen in text
findings.title: Tutorial makes two skill tracks legible
findings.claim: Tutorial explains faster, stronger generation levels versus slower persistent instincts. Skill tooltip displays both XP/levels/multipliers and total.
findings.limits_or_contradiction: Useful text UI evidence, no rendered usability claim.

findings.label: seen in data or code
findings.title: Automation is earned per action across lives
findings.claim: Reincarnation unlocks actions whose cumulative timesCompleted reaches requirement. Defaults: jobs 400, construction 8, exploration 8 or repeatable 40; overrides include berries 200, wood 200, cart 5, hut 6, first exploration 7. Related route alternatives can lower the requirement by floor(other completions/2); minimum 1.
findings.locators: decoded.js:13452-13475 a0_0x4cc901; 13161-13183; jobs 0/1 at 2669-2720; construction 0/1 at 4990-5033; exploration 0 at 6399-6416
findings.limits_or_contradiction: Unlock can wait until next generation; repeated completion does not mean automation was available in the first life.

findings.label: seen in data or code
findings.title: Automation is priorities and eligibility, not free production
findings.claim: Off/low/regular/high/top priorities. Scheduler checks eligible food/resources, construction, exploration and refills; food depletion can schedule an urgent refill. Construction has incremental resource use. Action visibility and affordability still matter.
findings.limits_or_contradiction: Manual planning remains relevant around new gates and changing supply access.

findings.label: seen in data or code
findings.title: Offline catch-up can spend life and reach death
findings.claim: Elapsed wall-time addition is capped at 259200000 ms (three days) per timestamp-gap calculation. Shared action loop consumes it, including health damage; paused/menu/death states clear or hold backlog according to options. Catch-up accelerates until the next stopping point; normal reincarnation remains a button command.
findings.limits_or_contradiction: Contradicts a blanket promise of no aging/life depletion while closed. Three-day added-gap cap is not proof total stored backlog cannot exceed three days.

findings.label: seen in data or code
findings.title: Empty queues protect the player
findings.claim: No eligible automated work and no active action returns without advancing life; tickCounter is cleared. Manual pause and menu handling likewise prevent unintended active advancement, with opt-in offline-in-menu behavior.
findings.limits_or_contradiction: Idle is intentional work; waiting for input need not consume life.

findings.label: seen in data or code
findings.title: Resource and building worlds reset
findings.claim: Inventory amounts/lastUse are cleared and completed structures lose isFinished on ordinary rebirth. Progress/completion count/encounter discovery are separate fields. Persistent discovery remembers an action existed without leaving its bridge standing.
findings.limits_or_contradiction: Directly contradicts treating every earlier house/stash as heir property.

findings.label: seen in data or code
findings.title: Artifacts deliberately persist through a named carrier
findings.claim: Funnel hourglass (161) permanently reduces food cooldown by 1% per completion, with 1.1 completion difficulty scaling and extra damage. Shield (190), tooth (228), core (304) feed permanent combat, food and completion-damage effects. Powers read retained completion counts.
findings.limits_or_contradiction: Source supports artifact-mediated carry as one local option. It does not prove any YAIR soul/bloodline mechanism.

findings.label: seen in data or code
findings.title: First life and later lives have different work burdens
findings.claim: Opening gathers berries/wood, explores a lake, unlocks raw fish and campfire cooking, fights a cave spider, builds a bridge and raft. All gates repeat after death, but instincts and automation shorten or remove earlier manual tasks. Skill panels reveal new skills from past completion/instincts.
findings.limits_or_contradiction: No measured first-life duration or late-run speed is claimed.

findings.label: seen in data or code
findings.title: Text records events, then compares performance
findings.claim: Exploration completion writes story progress, per-life logs retain event IDs/times. Rebirth keeps last-life log and three detailed generation snapshots with time allocation, XP and furthest exploration. Tables/tooltips/progress bars expose action states and costs.
findings.limits_or_contradiction: This is a bounded performance history, not a full genealogy.

findings.label: seen in data or code
findings.title: Restart generation is not reincarnation
findings.claim: a0_0x8286b5 restores start-of-life instincts and completion counts, removes the death health reward if awarded, rolls statistics back and refunds elapsed simulated time to tickCounter. It does not increment generation.
findings.limits_or_contradiction: A replay/undo affordance differs from an earned new life; do not combine their retention contracts.

findings.label: seen in data or code
findings.title: NG+ is a separate larger reset
findings.claim: a0_0x499831 keeps NG+ DNA/perk selection but resets generation to 1, max health to 100, skills/action tables/history and current chapter progression. Requirement scale is 0.999^earned NG+ DNA with minimum one completion.
findings.limits_or_contradiction: Dormant DNA-upgrade helpers and commented ordinary-death DNA UI are not evidence that the old shop is the current ordinary-rebirth interface.

findings.label: seen in text
findings.title: Developer acknowledges optimization friction
findings.claim: Automation settings describe players adjusting priorities mid-run and offer exhausted-job overrides to reduce manual repetition. Other tooltips caution that specialized settings are confusing before learning the system.
findings.limits_or_contradiction: This is developer-authored acknowledgement, not a sampled player-review finding. No player reviews were collected.

findings.label: inferred
findings.title: Design costs of the implemented loop
findings.claim: Repeated rebuilding and route traversal can become repetition; exponentiating survival rewards can encourage time farming; death during catch-up can surprise players; a three-generation cap trades history detail for bounded storage. These follow mechanisms, not measured dissatisfaction.
findings.limits_or_contradiction: No game ranking, no general design ban, no assertion players universally dislike these choices.

findings.label: seen in data or code
findings.title: No reviewed heir/family simulation
findings.claim: Fresh state and ordinary reset hold skills, actions, inventory, logs and options rather than parent/child, inheritance-law or independent family-agent records. Reincarnation is applied to the same player state.
findings.limits_or_contradiction: Useful counterexample for the assignment topic; not support for autonomous families or random successor plans.
